products.title: Secret Roll-On Powder Fresh, 1.8 oz (12-Pack)
products.description: A classic Powder Fresh antiperspirant and deodorant made for women, with a pH-balanced formula designed to be gentle on skin. The brand promises 24-hour sweat and odor protection, wrapped in a clean, light powder scent that stays pleasant without feeling heavy. It goes on smooth and dries quickly, so there is no sticky feeling or white marks on clothes during a busy day. Whether you use it for daily wear or active days, this 12-pack makes it easy to stock up and keep a spare in every bag.
